note: Style 2026-10: Pinterest = laptop + numbered callouts (shots/rec/pins_v2.py), IG/FB = tilted 'photo' of the same screen. crop/targets are in screenshot pixels. insert_at = rotation index where new pins start, alternating new/old (Pinterest was at 15 on 2026-10-14). launch: pins with launch=true skip the normal mix and are inserted from launch_at, one every launch_every slots (new products).
